issues.explanation: The conjunctive form is read おちつき, not the dictionary-form reading おちつく.
issues.suggested_fix: Set kana to おちつき.

issues.explanation: This continuative form is read み, not みる.
The surface form is read おもった, not おもう.
issues.suggested_fix: Set kana to おもった.

issues.explanation: This form is read わすれ before the auxiliary, not わすれる.
The surface is read られ, not られる.
This 未然形 is read かざら, not かざる.
The auxiliary surface is read れ, not れる.
The segment で is the continuative form of the copula, so it is an auxiliary rather than a particle.
issues.suggested_fix: Mark で as an auxiliary with lemma だ.

issues.explanation: In ような, な is the attributive form of the copula and should be analyzed as an auxiliary, not a particle.
issues.suggested_fix: Mark な as an auxiliary with lemma だ.

issues.explanation: The continuative form before て is read つきだし, not つきだす.
issues.suggested_fix: Set kana to つきだし.

issues.explanation: The conjunctive form before て is read しみ, not しみる.
The surface before the past auxiliary is read くるしん, not くるしむ.
issues.suggested_fix: Set kana to くるしん.

issues.explanation: The past form is read しった, not しる.
In ことである, で is the continuative form of the copula, not a particle.
issues.suggested_fix: Mark で as an auxiliary with lemma だ.

issues.explanation: The form before て is read すわっ, not すわる.
The overlay includes 薬缶, which is not part of the ような comparison construction.
issues.suggested_fix: Use the exact grammatical surface のような, with the corresponding adjusted offsets.

issues.explanation: The overlay labels のは, but its surface also includes 知った, which is outside that nominalization/topic construction.
issues.suggested_fix: Use the exact grammatical surface のは, with the corresponding adjusted offsets.
